name: worker_bootstrap

test_list.description: The worker rejects short, invalid UTF-8, and non-hex parent credentials before binding a local endpoint.

inputs.name: parent_credential
inputs.description: A parent-issued worker secret transferred through inherited stdin before any endpoint is bound.

inputs.name: stdin_lifecycle
inputs.description: After credential bytes, an extra byte or EOF requests graceful worker shutdown.

output_description: A zeroizing bootstrap reader validates the secret before server startup without putting credentials in argv or environment variables.
